'''Bross''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Gold Squadron (New Republic)|Gold Squadron]], and the [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmate]] of [[Wing Commander/Legends|Wing Commander]] [[Greni]]. Both were shot down during a [[Battle of Hettsk|battle]] over [[Hettsk]], which was located in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]]. The two pilots were captured by invading [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces and subsequently [[Mission to Hettsk|rescued]] by the [[Katarn Commandos]].
